meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

howto.when: 当你需要查询公开的版本化单细胞/空间转录组数据,如按物种、组织、疾病、细胞类型等筛选基因表达或元数据时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude can query the CZ CELLxGENE Census for public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data, retrieving cell metadata, gene expression slices, summary counts, H5AD URIs, and embeddings, and integrate with Scanpy or PyTorch workflows.
howto.when_en: Use when you need programmatic access to versioned public single-cell/spatial data, e.g., filtering by organism, tissue, disease, or cell type for expression or metadata.
